page_title: CRY 1-2 TOT | Crystal Palace v Tottenham Hotspur 27/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+12' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
90+11' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Crystal Palace was in an offside position.
90+11' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
90+9' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+9' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) for his blatant foul.
90+9' The corner from Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by Guglielmo Vicario.
90+8' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Crystal Palace have a corner.
90+7' Andy Madley sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
90+5' The Crystal Palace players halt their celebrations as referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
90+4' 1 - 2 Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
90+3' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 10:2.
90+1' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Dejan Kulusevski is replaced by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
89' Substitution. James Maddison will be replaced by Bryan Gil (Tottenham).
87' None of the Crystal Palace players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
87' Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play and Crystal Palace manage to earn a corner.
87' Crystal Palace take a short corner kick.

86' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. The referee blows his whistle, Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
86' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Crystal Palace will take a corner kick.
84' Neat link-up play between Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) and James Maddison, but Sam Johnstone reads the game well and the move breaks down.
83' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
83' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
83' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham). Tottenham force a corner. They send men into the box.
82' Neat passing move from Tottenham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
80' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
79' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
79' Roy Hodgson decides to make a substitution. Odsonne Edouard will be replaced by Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace).
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) coming on for Jefferson Lerma.
77' Crystal Palace have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

77' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Crystal Palace will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
73' Tottenham are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
70' Roy Hodgson has decided to make a change. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) replaces Will Hughes.
70' Roy Hodgson is forced to make a change. Tyrick Mitchell is unable to continue due to injury, Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) comes on.
68' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
66' 0 - 2 Goal! Brennan Johnson tees up Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the right side of the goal. 0:2.
64' The linesman raises his flag. Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is adjudged offside.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) comes onto the pitch for Richarlison.
64' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Yves Bissouma and he is replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
63' Richarlison (Tottenham) tries to find Heung-Min Son, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
62' The total number of attempts is 10:5.
60' It will be a substitution. Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) is ready to enter the pitch as Jeffrey Schlupp walks off.
58' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is penalised for holding. Andy Madley signals a set piece.
55' Will Hughes sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace), whose close-range header flashes just wide of the left post.
55' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

55' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Good work from Crystal Palace as they win a corner.
53' 0 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) puts the ball into his own net.

52' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
51' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) takes the corner with a short pass.
50' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
50' The linesman raises his flag for offside before James Maddison (Tottenham) heads on.
48' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
47' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ange Postecoglou probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ben Davies. He is replaced by Emerson Royal (Tottenham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Andy Madley has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The ball possession is 28:72.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
42' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
42' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
41' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Crystal Palace.
41' The resulting corner from Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

41' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Crystal Palace get a corner.
40' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) whips in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned and punches the ball away.
40' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
39' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
38' James Maddison (Tottenham) commits a foul and Andy Madley immediately signals a free kick.
37' Ben Davies (Tottenham) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
36' A dangerous looking corner kick from Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is cleared to safety by the defence.

36' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
35' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is able to continue to play.
33' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
32' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
29' James Maddison (Tottenham) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Dejan Kulusevski, but Sam Johnstone displays great awareness to stop him.
27' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
26' James Maddison (Tottenham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
23' Surely that's handball by one of the Tottenham players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
23' Richarlison (Tottenham) trips an opposition player and Andy Madley signals a foul.
21' Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Richarlison (Tottenham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.

17' Richarlison sprays a pass out to James Maddison (Tottenham), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
16' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
15' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Tottenham win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
14' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
13' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts the ball.
12' Andy Madley blows his whistle after Richarlison (Tottenham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
10' James Maddison (Tottenham) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

7' A neat pass is well received by Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.

6' A sweet pass finds Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Guglielmo Vicario is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
5' Ben Davies (Tottenham) tries to find Richarlison with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
2' Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
1' The first half has started.
Tottenham will kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Andy Madley will referee today's match.
